steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q sd/sd_mix2.m4a)" = b1c9676fc9e51598938c4bd9ff8764a6 ] && [ "$(md5 -q sd_out.mp4)" = b767dd1a37a1df003bd83385c91ce752 ] && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sd_out.mp4 -i sd/sd_mix2.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest sd_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sd_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k sd_720.mp4 && ls -l sd_film.mp4 sd_720.mp4 > sd_done2.txt; cat sd_done2.txt
